findings.title: Missing accessibility test for ProjectSettings table name
findings.problem: The Table call site adds ariaLabel="Project integrations", but there is no accessibility test asserting the table's accessible name — the sibling call sites this same change touches (UserSettings, DataSourcesPage, WorkflowExecutionsTable) each got a matching *.accessibility.test.tsx with a getByRole('table', { name: ... }) assertion.
findings.impact: A future refactor can silently drop or rename the label on this call site with nothing failing to catch it, leaving the a11y fix unverified for Project integrations specifically.
findings.recommendation: Add a ProjectSettings accessibility test mirroring UserSettings.accessibility.test.tsx's table-name assertion: screen.getByRole('table', { name: 'Project integrations' }).
